verdict.rationale: Gladia's docs state language coverage per model: solaria-1 is described as a '100+ languages, async and live, code switching' generalist. They also give a per-feature figure, translation into '100 target languages', and mention configuring an explicit language list for code-switching. That is a first-party, model- and feature-aware statement of coverage, but the pack shows only aggregate counts, not an enumerated list. missing for 10: an actual published list of supported language names/codes, explicit per-model differences across all models, per-feature language matrices (live vs async, diarization, PII, sentiment), independent corroboration.
